title: EQNR-QF48: exact arbitrary-modulus carry recursion with polynomial space

claims.statement: For every integer N>=2 and every fixed s in Z/NZ, with n=ceil(log2 N), select the single FAST carry-retaining algorithm in leap-research/exact-all-n.md Section9.1, instantiated with QF48 in leap-research/quantum-fiber.md using its general signed-integer phase operation. It recovers the full s with unconditional probability at least2/3 from independent ideal mixed coset copies. For n>=2 use b=ceil(sqrt(n log2 n)), r=b+4, D=ceil((n-1)/b), A=8r/7, R=r^D, K=8192(ceil(log2 R)+ceil(log2 n)+30), F=nK+2n+1, C=ceil(3000F A^D), and q_label=ceil(log2(1000C)). All original acquisitions and combination attempts count toward the global node cutoffC; every source label rejection is charged. QF48 uses r_w=w+4, list cap1024 and48 trials per search, with no extra source copies. For n=1 use the specified eleven-tests-per-candidate branch. Total charged work is T=O(n^7 2^(sqrt(n log2 n)+(5/4)sqrt(n))). This complete representative envelope has exact growth index1/2 and includes source costs, all retry/abort branches, label precision, decoder work, gate generation, addressing and exact Clifford+T operations. These bounds hold jointly for this one configuration on every branch, with absolute constants independent of N,s and outcomes.
